content.comment_body: Hello! I'm having trouble connecting my computer to [product_name] via Ethernet (using [article_no]). Communication isn't working so far. Appreciate any help. Split from [product_name] software not detecting [product_name].

The error suggests the PC/laptop and [product_name] are not on the same network segment or have different subnet masks.

analysis.insight_summary: Community members are working to resolve issues connecting a PC to [product_name] over Ethernet. Challenges stem from incorrect network configurations, notably mismatched IP addresses and subnet masks, preventing device recognition. Further troubleshooting involves hardware ports and firmware versions, revealing uncertainty about network defaults and device compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want easy Ethernet setup between PC and [product_name], with automatic or clearly documented network settings. The goal is reliable device detection and communication for programming tasks.
